The indicator fulfillment by region and hospital measures the proportion of patients receiving antibiotic treatment within three hours (Indicator 1) across [[danmark|Danmark]]. Nationally, the fulfillment rate has shown a steady upward trend, rising from 26.8% in 2021/22 to 30.5% in 2022/23, and reaching 34.4% in the current reporting period [^src1]. 

Among the five regions, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] leads with a fulfillment rate of 44.6%, followed by [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] at 36.7% and [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] at 36.3% [^src1]. Conversely, [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] trails significantly at 22.5%, while [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] stands at 33.1% [^src1]. 

At the hospital level, [[regionshospitalet-randers|Regionshospitalet Randers]] achieves the highest fulfillment rate at 50.8%, closely followed by [[regionshospitalet-goedstrup|Regionshospitalet Gødstrup]] (47.3%), [[aarhus-universitetshospital|Aarhus Universitetshospital]] (46.8%), and [[holbaek-sygehus|Holbæk Sygehus]] (46.6%) [^src1]. The lowest performing hospitals are [[esbjerg-sygehus-grindsted-sygehus|Esbjerg Sygehus Grindsted Sygehus]] at 18.2% and [[rigshospitalet|Rigshospitalet]] at 19.2% [^src1]. Other notable low performers include [[odense-universitetshospital-svendborg|Odense Universitetshospital - Svendborg]] and [[sygehus-lillebaelt|Sygehus Lillebælt]], both at 22.8% [^src1].

Several hospitals exhibit significant volatility or outliers in their year-over-year performance. [[bornholms-hospital|Bornholms Hospital]] experienced a drastic decline, dropping from a high of 63.3% in 2022/23 to 38.5% in the current period, despite being at 31.8% in 2021/22 [^src1]. In contrast, [[odense-universitetshospital-svendborg|Odense Universitetshospital - Svendborg]] showed substantial improvement, nearly tripling its rate from 7.9% in 2022/23 (and 6.1% in 2021/22) to 22.8% [^src1]. [[bispebjerg-og-frederiksberg-hospitaler|Bispebjerg og Frederiksberg Hospitaler]] saw a decrease from 38.0% in 2022/23 to 29.3% currently [^src1]. 

Data for [[aalborg-universitetshospital-thisted|Aalborg Universitetshospital, Thisted]] is largely unreported or missing for the current period, with only a "0,0" recorded for the fulfilled denominator percentage, marking it as a distinct outlier in data completeness [^src1]. Other hospitals like [[amager-og-hvidovre-hospital|Amager og Hvidovre Hospital]], [[herlev-og-gentofte-hospital|Herlev og Gentofte Hospital]], [[hospitalerne-i-nordsjaelland|Hospitalerne i Nordsjælland]], [[naestved-slagese-og-ringsted-sygehuse|Næstved, Slagelse og Ringsted sygehuse]], [[sjaellands-universitetshospital|Sjællands Universitetshospital]], [[sygehus-soenderjylland|Sygehus Sønderjylland]], [[hospitalsenhed-midt|Hospitalsenhed Midt]], [[regionshospitalet-horsens|Regionshospitalet Horsens]], [[aalborg-universitetshospital|Aalborg Universitetshospital]], and [[regionshospital-nordjylland|Regionshospital Nordjylland]] show varying degrees of fulfillment, generally tracking near or slightly above and below their respective regional averages [^src1].

Additional indicators, methodological details, and extended regional analyses are documented across the broader clinical database publications [^src2] [^src3] [^src4] [^src5] [^src6] [^src7] [^src8] [^src9] [^src10] [^src11] [^src12] [^src13] [^src14] [^src15] [^src16] [^src17] [^src18] [^src19].
